title: The Two Gentlemen of Verona
html_source: Believed by some to be Shakespeare’s first original play. Infidelity is a theme in the work.

anchor.prefix: or all three in one is to Shakespeare, what the poor is not, always with him. The note of banishment, banishment from the heart, banishment from home, sounds uninterruptedly from
anchor.suffix: onward till Prospero breaks his staff, buries it certain fathoms in the earth and drowns his book. It doubles itself in the middle of his life, reflects itself in another, repeats
